Overview

Piracicaba is a city in SP with a population of 410,517. An important industrial and educational center in São Paulo, known for its sugar and ethanol industry and the historic Rua do Porto. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
